name: A zero-count payment status exposes Clear filters and restores All
description:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
2. Select the first status tab showing a zero count.
3. Confirm the empty state and Clear filters action.
4. Clear the filters and confirm All is selected with the search cleared.
